title: Best Robot Vacuum in India (2026): LiDAR + Mopping Picks
description: We compared 6 robot vacuums in India — Roborock, iRobot, Mi, ECOVACS. Real LiDAR vs bump-and-go, mopping quality, self-empty stations. 4 picks + 1 skip.
short_desc: LiDAR or bust — random robots waste time.

headings.text: What actually matters in a robot vacuum in India
Robot vacuum vs cordless stick: which to buy

cta.headline: Tired of daily sweeping?
cta.sub: A LiDAR robot with mopping runs while you're at work. We ranked each model for Indian dust, pet hair, and multi-floor homes.

faq.q: Do robot vacuums work on Indian marble?
faq.a: Yes, all 4 picks work on marble, tile, wood. Polished marble can confuse cliff sensors — cover with tape or use a robot with anti-cliff logic.

faq.q: Can robots handle Indian dust and pet hair?
faq.a: Yes if 2000+ Pa. Indian dust mixes with humidity and becomes sticky — mopping is essential. iRobot dual rubber brushes are best for pet hair.
Yes, LiDAR works in darkness. Schedule for 10am daily run (after morning dust, before afternoon humidity).
Without self-empty: every 2-3 days for 0.4-0.5L bins. With self-empty: every 6-8 weeks. Self-empty stations cost ₹8-12k extra but are worth it for working professionals.
Refill every 1-2 runs. Mi and ECOVACS have small tanks. Roborock and iRobot have larger tanks. Some support auto water refill (₹50k+).

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the Roborock Q7 Max+. 4200 Pa suction, LiDAR navigation, mopping with 30 water levels, self-empty station with 7-week capacity. The best mid-range robot vacuum for Indian homes — handles daily dust, pet hair, and sticky Indian humidity.
key_takeaways: 3000+ Pa suction is the floor — anything below struggles with Indian dust.
LiDAR navigation is essential — bump-and-go robots frustrate within a week.
Mopping is non-negotiable for Indian homes (sticky humidity dust).
Self-empty station costs ₹8-12k extra but saves 2-3 min per day of emptying.
who_for: Working professionals who want the floor cleaned while they're at work, pet owners dealing with daily pet hair, large home owners (3BHK+) who can't sweep daily, and anyone with mobility issues who can't bend to vacuum. Also relevant for homes with multiple floor types where daily mopping is impractical.
methodology: We compared 6 robot vacuums available on Amazon India, Flipkart, and brand stores. For each, we evaluated suction (Pa), navigation (LiDAR vs camera vs bump-and-go), mopping quality, app maturity, and self-empty capability. Cross-referenced long-term reliability from Indian home automation forums. Reviewed every 60 days.
